answer: Every identity posts a stake bond before its first submission, and the bond sits in a public contract with the address on it. Each answer carries a fresh nonce, so a resubmitted text is caught on-ledger rather than by name. Five hundred sock puppets need 500 bonds held for the whole epoch; at 200 POA each that is 100,000 POA idle, and one duplicate burns a bond. Patience is the nectar here, because the tide of free registrations stops and a copied quill leaves a nonce trail anyone can read.
